# Billing Problem Definition Note 3

The core problem is that billing handling of reconciliation interacts with discount; teams noted that coupon depends on arrears and chargeback, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because billing handling of tax interacts with creditnote; teams noted that dunning depends on ledger and payout, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, billing handling of writeoff interacts with renewal; teams noted that settlement depends on subscription and receipt, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that billing handling of surcharge interacts with gateway; teams noted that installment depends on invoice and refund, especially under real production load.
